reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses degradation in both oxidizing and reducing gases as required, proposes a physically sound grain-boundary mechanism for this alloy class, and provides a specific, testable intervention with clear baseline and falsification criteria. Hypothesis B focuses only on oxidation, neglects reducing environments, and includes unjustified quantitative predictions (30–50% strength decrease) and a mechanism (FCC-to-HCP suppression) not well supported for this composition and temperature regime.
